_doc: Frozen LoRA target set for Qwen3.5-9B (PLAN.md §1.2). Equals what LF `lora_target: all` resolves to: every Linear4bit in model.language_model.layers (248 modules); vision tower (110 linears), merger and lm_head excluded. Matches the target_modules of all 18 challenge Qwen3.5 adapters. Recorded 2026-10-13.
P8_note: Exact trainable-parameter count of one r=8 LoRA on this set (LF dry run, 2026-10-13); equals 8*sum(in+out) over the 248 modules.
